title: Clarify Mutex API TTL GC storage flavor in Gherkin
description:
SD nit #6 on PR #278: minor TTL GC storage flavor gap on live-lease-only DynamoDB semantics.

Specify that abandoned leases expire and are garbage-collected (DynamoDB TTL when that provider is configured) without storing Kanbus history in the mutex store.
right_now_summary: The Gherkin spec is being clarified to cover TTL cleanup without storing Kanbus history in the mutex store.
